text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I had no shell tool here. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, so please run the suite to confirm.

- **`search.py`**: it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`**: `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`**: `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies, so 4 days late gives 1.00.
- **`factory.py`**: `sample_books` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my guess, since the tests only check the title.
- **`inventory.py`**: `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n <= 0`.
- **`books.py`**: `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int, which also fixes `age()`.
